# jamfprotect_unified_logging_filter_sets (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of all unified logging filter sets in Jamf Protect. Filter sets group unified logging filters and scope them to plans.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfprotect_unified_logging_filter_sets" "example" {}

# Output all unified logging filter sets
output "all_unified_logging_filter_sets" {
  value = data.jamfprotect_unified_logging_filter_sets.example.unified_logging_filter_sets
}

# Find the "Default" set that Jamf Protect creates for tenants which had unified
# logging filters enabled before filter sets existed
output "default_filter_set" {
  value = [
    for set in data.jamfprotect_unified_logging_filter_sets.example.unified_logging_filter_sets :
    set if set.name == "Default"
  ]
}

# Filter sets that are not assigned to any plan, and therefore ship nothing
output "unassigned_filter_sets" {
  value = [
    for set in data.jamfprotect_unified_logging_filter_sets.example.unified_logging_filter_sets :
    set.name if length(set.plans) == 0
  ]
}

# Map each filter set to the plans it is assigned to
output "filter_sets_by_plan" {
  value = {
    for set in data.jamfprotect_unified_logging_filter_sets.example.unified_logging_filter_sets :
    set.name => [for plan in set.plans : plan.name]
  }
}
```

- `unified_logging_filter_sets` (Attributes List) The list of unified logging filter sets, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--unified_logging_filter_sets))

### Nested Schema for `unified_logging_filter_sets`

Read-Only:

- `filters` (Attributes List) Unified logging filters included in this filter set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--unified_logging_filter_sets--filters))
- `name` (String) The name of the unified logging filter set.
- `plans` (Attributes List) Plans that this filter set is assigned to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--unified_logging_filter_sets--plans))
- `updated` (String) The last-updated timestamp.
- `uuid` (String) The unique identifier of the unified logging filter set.
